title: gravitas.library-search/1
description: The Library's search index, the file library/search-index.json that tools/build-library.mjs writes and js/library/search.js fetches on the first query: for each Library entry id, the entry's learning objectives in English and Spanish. It is generated, never edited; the reader (js/libraryPage.js) does not check its version, so this states what the generator writes. FORMATS.md lists it.
